profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer | Full-Stack Engineer | Product Developer | Agentic AI

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead software development across cloud, backend, frontend, and infrastructure for driver education and insurance technology platforms. I work across architecture and product development, building scalable AWS-based services and applications while partnering with stakeholders to turn business requirements into production systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed software and infrastructure for gaming and casino systems, working across React, .NET, SQL, deployment automation, and hardware integrations.  Worked hands-on with application development and providing OTA updates to distributed systems.
positions.insights: Skills: System Architecture · .NET Framework · Web Application Development · Microsoft SQL Server · Amazon EC2

positions.title: Electronics and Software Design Engineer
positions.description: Developed embedded and software systems for instrumentation and data-acquisition applications. Worked on real-time data processing, device communication, wireless power control, and embedded systems.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Built technology for interactive tabletop gaming that connected physical game components with digital multiplayer experiences. Worked across Unity, embedded hardware, RFID, and backend systems to create prototypes and software platforms for connected games.

positions.title: Lead Product Developer
positions.description: Developed and shipped DIY electronic kits combining embedded software, electronics, sensors, and microcontrollers. Worked hands-on across prototyping, hardware integration, firmware, sourcing, and technical documentation.

positions.title: Electrical Engineer
positions.description: Worked on an adaptive-lens technology project involving electronic control, embedded systems, and real-time software. Designed and integrated the electronics and software needed to control variations of focal length.

positions.title: Product Developer
positions.description:
•Sourced materials from China and acted as liaison with oversea manufacturer to discuss hardware requirements, manufacturing cost, and time.
•Tested and integrated battery charging circuits, PV cells, and DC micro-motors for product line.
•Created test cases to verify product life expectancy, airflow-power efficiency, and product safety.
•Designed 3-D model of product prototype using SolidWorks.
•Wrote product specification and documentation.

projects.title: Battle Grid
projects.description:
Lead Design Engineer
Battle Grid is a two-player game designed using Unity3D combined with our proprietary RFID scanning hardware.  Players destroy each other by playing cards to activate abilities for their smart pieces.
•Designed 3D environment using Unity Asset Store.
•Creat/Read/Write to JSON manifest that hosts RFID data.
•Scripted sounds, events, special effects, and core game logic.

projects.title: Plants vs Zombies - Prizm Edition
projects.description:
Lead Design Engineer
Porting of Plants vs Zombies on Prizm Hardware (Demonstration purposes only)
With Prizm's technology, Plants vs Zombies now requires physical smart pieces to grow plants.  This new way to play enables the popular single-player game to become an immersive and engaging multiplayer game.
•Reused Battle Grid framework.
•Scripted sounds, events, and special affects, and core game logic.
